intro: Lesson 31 homework. Mark it yourself with the mark scheme.

questions.a: A program that performs a housekeeping or maintenance task, e.g. backup, compression, anti-malware

questions.q: Give one example of user management carried out by an operating system.
questions.a: User accounts with passwords and access rights

questions.q: Why should a backup be stored away from the main site?
questions.a: So it survives fire, flood or theft at the main site

questions.q: What is an audit trail, and why is it useful?
questions.a: A record of who did what and when; it helps to trace errors and misuse

questions.q: Give two differences between high-level and low-level languages.
questions.a: High-level: English-like, easier to read, portable, needs a compiler or interpreter. Low-level: close to machine code, hardware-specific, harder to read, can be faster
An executable file of machine code (object code)

questions.q: Why does an interpreted program run more slowly than a compiled one?
questions.a: Each line is translated every time the program runs

questions.q: Name two features of an IDE that help with debugging.
questions.a: Any two: error messages with line numbers, breakpoints, stepping through code, watching variables
